evidence_disposition: Correction needed for source-role and selection-rationale metadata on all nine exact IDs; published tier and parent suitability remain unresolved for engineering.
role_evidence: RESOLVE 2017 item and feature properties define natural/ecological ecoregions, not political units. The nine source IDs are ecoregion features clipped to the named Cordillera or Velasco 2015 ADM2 predecessor.

source_accounting.mapping: Cordillera has five portions; Velasco has four. All 110 source ADM2 features are accounted as 108 directly matched administrative locations plus these two complete predecessor polygons.

neighbor_assessment.cross_region_source_consistency: No source-to-source cross-border check was performed. These current contacts do not establish inconsistency; coordinate any future shared-edge correction with #489 and affected regional owners.

proposed_correction.source_role: Do not call these provinces. Use a canonical non-administrative physical-geography source role only if engineering confirms the vocabulary; otherwise leave this administrative-only role unset.
proposed_correction.location_basis: Replace the generic rural-district description with: named RESOLVE ECO_ID physical region intersected with its named 2015 ADM2 predecessor polygon; not an administrative subdivision.
proposed_correction.selection_reason: Replace the administrative-unit granularity rationale with the documented ecological/physical selection basis.
proposed_correction.tier: Keep descriptive administrative_level “Named physical region portion” pending engineering review of whether such physical portions belong in the published location collection at this tier.
preserve: Santa Cruz parent pending tier decision
all original source bytes and historical attributes

limits: 2015 province and 2017 RESOLVE data (service last edited 2022-01-27) are not current official Bolivian boundary evidence. GeoBolivia catalog record access returned HTTP 403 in parent work; no present official row-level crosswalk was established.

Source/current predecessor union differences are 393.563 km² (0.47%) for Cordillera and 200.774 km² (0.29%) for Velasco; these do not select a correct boundary or authorize a line move. Per-fragment expected-area coverage spans 93.300%–99.830%.

Each fragment has an explicit unresolved settlement disposition; named settlement, inland-water/island and official unnamed-remainder inventories are incomplete. Geometry component counts and GSHHG centroid screen are not completeness proofs.
Ecological identity, political ownership, historical status and administrative tier are separate evidence.
